newsitem.title: FRANCE: French-treated nuclear waste heads back to Japan.
newsitem.headline: French-treated nuclear waste heads back to Japan.

text.p: A large load of processed nuclear waste will leave the French port of Cherbourg on Monday on its way back to Japan, the French processing firm Cogema said on Saturday.
The cargo will be loaded onto the "Pacific Teal" which was expected at Cherbourg later on Saturday, a Cogema statement said.
The processed waste, packed into 40 containers, was discreetly shipped by train to Cherbourg early on Friday under heavy police guard from the nuclear reprocessing plant at La Hague in N ormandy.

Previous shipments to Japan and elsewhere have caused an outcry among anti-nuclear militants. Thousands of protesters battled police in Germany when one such shipment from France arrived there last May.
